senses.ms_definition: Bentuk yang belum dikenal pasti makna dan golongan katanya berdasarkan bahan yang diberikan.
senses.nuances: 这是核验说明，不是已确认的词汇义项。MAE 确为 Maybank 使用的应用名称，但不能仅凭小写 mae 就认定输入指该产品，也不能排除姓名等其他来源。[Maybank 官方 MAE 说明](https://www.maybank2u.com.my/maybank2u/malaysia/en/personal/frequent_queries/mae-app/app-information.page)。以下仅为讨论该字符串的元语言组合，不是已确认的高频词汇搭配。

etymology.historical_story: An isolated lowercase token can hide distinctions that ordinary writing preserves through capital letters and context. Maybank officially uses MAE as an application name, but that documented brand does not identify every occurrence of mae. Without the original sentence or document, assigning this token a borrowing history, name origin, or Malay derivation would be speculation.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先看大小写，再看上下文：mae 暂不定义；只有语境确认后，才把它与 MAE 等具体名称关联。
